parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results.

parameters.name: SortOrder
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

- **Ascending**: sorts the results in ascending order.

- **Descending** (default): sorts the results in descending order.
